messages:
zoe: PSA: spotted a lonely potted plant in the 3rd-floor hallway by the elevators. pot was cracked, leaves droopy :slightly_frowning_face:
matt: omg poor fern. looks like it escaped from someone's desk.
tina: Foto?
zoe: posted pic: https://imgur.com/plantrescue123 50 (tiny fern, sad soil level)
leo: i can bring potting soil and a spare terracotta. rescue mission? :raised_hands:
olivia: i'm allergic to *most* plants but will cheer from afar. good luck heroes. :v:
facilities-bot: Heads up: watering rota is automated via the plant-care sheet. If you adopt, update the sheet: https://redwood-internal/plant-care
matt: @leo love to recruit you for repotting. when works? 10:30am tomorrow?
leo: works for me. can bring tiny trowel and a label: `Rescued 3F - do not eat`.
tina: i'll bring a spray mister and a new pebble drainage layer. also marker for label.
zoe: should we name it? suggestions: Sir Photos-a-Lot, Fernie Sanders, Leaf Erickson.
olivia: Sir Photos-a-Lot wins. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
facilities-bot: Note: plants cannot be placed in server rooms. keep on desks or common areas.
matt: quick poll 1: react with :seedling: to adopt it to the kitchen counter, :office: to claim for your desk, :house: if you want it at home (we'll arrange).
leo: :office:
tina: :seedling:
zoe: :office:
olivia: :house: (i said i'm allergic but i miss plants)
matt: consensus leans desk-rescue. i'll add entry to plant-care sheet and bring an extra tag: "Sir Photos-a-Lot - water weekly".
zoe: big thanks team. kudos to facilities for quick checks. 
leo: micro DIY repot squad assemble 10:30 tomorrow outside kitchen. bring curiosity, gloves optional. :seedling:
zoe: thread closed 1: Sir Photos-a-Lot awaiting adoption mission.
